texts: bad: the question asks for a maintained state named `burning` and binds the lanterns as a definite group, but a statement of this same habit would file the state under the verb `burn` with the -ing recorded as an aspect marker, and would leave a bare-plural object as the bare kind `lantern` — so the query can never match the stored fact. The deeper trouble is the phrasing itself: "keep X V-ing" maintaining an ongoing activity has no settled form in the translator (only a resultant state does, as in "kept the gate shut"), so the lanterns' role in the burning is left undecided. Rewrite with a plain adjectival result state and a definite object: "Why does Aelmere keep the lanterns alight every night?" ("keep the lanterns lit" works the same way).
